text:
Maria Chen: ap-southeast1 GPUs are spiking Pending state, autoscaler isn't provisioning new gpu nodes. 50+ pods stuck in Pending :frowning:
Ajay Patel: seeing the same, pods showing "0/1 nodes are available: 1 Insufficient gpu" in events
Kyle S.: checked cloud console — quota looks fine for GPUs but VPC quota for static IPs is at limit in that region
Maria Chen: here's kubeevents snippet:
```
Normal 10s (x12 over 4m) pod/svc Pending: 0/1 nodes are available: 1 Insufficient gpu
Warning 2s (x3 over 1m) pod/svc FailedScheduling: pod has unbound immediate PersistentVolumeClaims
```
Sofia: also noticing nodepool provisioning jobs keep failing with attach ENI timeout from cloud side
infra-bot: [ALERT] ap-southeast1 provisioning error rate 4.6% (5m) — rate exceeding threshold
Ajay Patel: autoscaler logs show CreateNodeGroup returned 500 from cloud API, retrying. kube-controller-manager not seeing new nodes after 30s
Kyle S.: suspecting ENI exhaustion -> cloud refuses to attach NICs so instance creation fails and autoscaler interprets as transient error, backs off
Maria Chen: can we shift traffic to fallback region (ap-northeast1/us-west1) for the next 30m? routing policy allows weighted split
Sofia: quick option — add ephemeral burst pool in us-west1 with relaxed affinity and reroute 40% of new requests. but that'll cost more
Kyle S.: manual steps: 1) update router weights in console 2) scale down ingress LB stickiness TTL to 30s 3) create burst nodepool
Ajay Patel: doing step 1 now — updating weight to ap-southeast1:60%, us-west1:40% -> applying
deploy-bot: router update applied (change id rtr-98321) by Ajay Patel
Maria Chen: creating burst pool in us-west1 with smaller GPU instance type (g4dn-ish) to handle short jobs
Sofia: I'm seeing cloud API returns:
```
{"error":"ENI quota exceeded","code":403}
```
Ajay Patel: requested quota increase but will take hours — ENI limit is the blocker
Maria Chen: for now, enable nodeAutoscaler fallback policy to allow cross-zone provision (we've used it before). Applying canary change.
Kyle S.: watch alerts; I'll spin up a synthetic job to validate routing change and node provisioning into us-west1
infra-bot: [INFO] Fallback routing enabled for customer-tier default at 1759991378
Sofia: provisioning in us-west1 started, instances are coming up but kubelet shows image pull slow — network throughput lower
Maria Chen: fine for now if pods start scheduling. Keep an eye on tail latency for generation routes
Ajay Patel: also toggled caching TTL to 45s to reduce burst token counts
Kyle S.: traffic shift validated — 38% of new sessions hitting us-west1 within 2m
Maria Chen: ops decision: keep weighted split for 2 hours, continue to request ENI quota, and follow up to create a dedicated hotpool for APAC with pre-allocated IPs so this doesn't repeat
Sofia: filing a follow-up infra ticket to track hotpool and quota request -> INFRA-4831
Ajay Patel: quick cost note — temporary burst pool projected +$2.5k for the period, finance looped in
Maria Chen: thanks everyone for quick pivot. I'll write a short postmortem after stabilizing and assign action items.
Kyle S.: 👍 will monitor for next 30m
Maria Chen: closing the incident thread in 1h unless new issues pop up.
